value.rationale: The new geometric object is the entire exceptional class where all planar projections have 3-fold rotational symmetry, rather than a selected harmonic. The factorization quantifies every projected area and proves exactly which three planes give maximal circular shadows; the inverse construction realizes an arbitrary multiset of these planes in a smooth strictly convex nonball. This supplies a complete, motivated and potentially reusable tomographic characterization, including degeneracy cases. It is not merely a small numerical constant improvement or a reparameterization of a known single-example calculation.
